purpose: Teach: 配付/減額/必需/構文/造る/充足/取消/買物

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様への資料配付を進めろ
lines.en: Distribute materials to our key clients. Move on it.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct gaze. Measured cadence, no softening. The tone of someone who expects immediate action and compliance without question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費の減額策を検討しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently looking into cost-reduction measures.
lines.style: Formal, respectful address. Steady delivery with slight upward inflection at the end, indicating both confirmation and readiness for the next instruction. Professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、必需品の在庫切れに注意しろ
lines.en: Watch for stock shortages on essential supplies.
lines.style: Sharp, declarative. Emphasis on the practical risk — not a suggestion but a mandate. Slightly elevated volume on the warning. Expectation of acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。マニュアルの構文を整理しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reorganized the manual procedures for clarity.
lines.style: Composed, matter-of-fact. Slightly faster pace than the opening — showing efficiency and forward momentum. Quiet confidence in having completed the task cleanly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、信頼を造る経営を心がけろ
lines.en: Build management around trust. Make that your priority.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate than the previous directive. Weight placed on the word 'trust.' This is not just instruction—it's principle. Slight pause before the second sentence for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の充足感を高める制度を導入します
lines.en: Yes. We're rolling out a new system to boost employee satisfaction.
lines.style: Warm shift from pure formality. Still professional, but with slight ease in the delivery. The word 'rolling out' carries minor pride—a concrete initiative taken. Cleaner, more human.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 注文取消の対応マニュアルを整えろ
lines.en: Put together a protocol for handling order cancellations.
lines.style: Brisk, focused. No preamble—straight to the task. Practical, no-nonsense tone. The cadence suggests this is a standard operational matter, handled matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、社員向け買物割引を始めました
lines.en: Yes. We've already started an employee discount program for shopping.
lines.style: Satisfied, conclusive tone. Slightly faster than earlier responses—showing momentum and initiative. Quiet pride in being ahead of the curve. A natural closing note.
